nodes.label: Pre-paint view/theme bootstrap script
nodes.rationale: Runs before first paint so the visitor lands in the view they last used (Developer mode or Spiral view) with that view's theme, avoiding a flash of the wrong view/theme. Each view keeps its own light/dark choice (localStorage theme-<view>); Spiral defaults light, Developer mode defaults dark. localStorage access wrapped in try/catch for blocked storage.

nodes.label: Per-view light/dark theme persistence
nodes.rationale: Theme stored per view (theme-spiral, theme-dev) so switching views restores each view's own light/dark choice.

nodes.label: Google Fonts (Host Grotesk, DM Mono, JetBrains Mono)
nodes.norm_label: google fonts (host grotesk, dm mono, jetbrains mono)

nodes.label: Dashboard editing workflow
nodes.rationale: Double-click Portfolio.cmd, edit at 127.0.0.1:7420/admin/, every change autosaves to docs/data.json, preview locally, then publish; keeps editing non-technical and local-only.

nodes.label: Project entry schema (title, tagline, year, type, tools, text, writeup, links, images)
nodes.rationale: Up to 50 projects; list order is spiral and ls order; tools spelled consistently because Developer mode grep searches them; first image is the spiral cover.
nodes.norm_label: project entry schema (title, tagline, year, type, tools, text, writeup, links, images)

nodes.label: Browser-side media pipeline (WebP 1600 px + 480 px -t thumbnail, video poster)
nodes.rationale: Images resized client-side before upload to keep the repo small; videos MP4/WebM up to 50 MB upload as-is with a poster frame about 1 s in, because GitHub refuses files over 100 MB.
nodes.norm_label: browser-side media pipeline (webp 1600 px + 480 px -t thumbnail, video poster)

nodes.label: Resume sections (jobs, courses, hackathons, leadership)
nodes.source_location: ### Add a job, course, hackathon or leadership role
nodes.rationale: Each section appears in About me, whoami and as a Developer mode file; the first word of the section name becomes its file name (e.g. experience.txt).

nodes.label: Site settings (headline, summary, contact links, name banner)
nodes.source_location: ### Change your name, headline or links
nodes.norm_label: site settings (headline, summary, contact links, name banner)

nodes.label: Manual publish (git add docs, commit, push; gh api pages build status)
nodes.norm_label: manual publish (git add docs, commit, push; gh api pages build status)

nodes.label: Troubleshooting (NOT SAVED, reserved port, publish failure, missing Node)
nodes.rationale: Windows reserves some ports so the dashboard falls back to a free one; NOT SAVED means the server console was closed; link previews are cached separately.
nodes.norm_label: troubleshooting (not saved, reserved port, publish failure, missing node)

nodes.label: Static site, no build step
nodes.rationale: HTML, CSS and one JS module with no backend, database, build step, analytics or paid service, so it can be hosted free on GitHub Pages.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages hosting (docs/ on main, liewjiaen.com)
nodes.norm_label: github pages hosting (docs/ on main, liewjiaen.com)

nodes.label: Cloudflare DNS for liewjiaen.com
nodes.rationale: Four A records to GitHub Pages and a www CNAME, all DNS only (grey cloud) so GitHub can issue the HTTPS certificate.

nodes.label: Google Fonts (Host Grotesk, DM Mono, JetBrains Mono)
nodes.norm_label: google fonts (host grotesk, dm mono, jetbrains mono)

nodes.label: mailto: Contact me
nodes.rationale: Visitors write from their own mail app so no backend is needed to receive messages.

nodes.label: Debounced autosave (400 ms after last keystroke)
nodes.norm_label: debounced autosave (400 ms after last keystroke)

nodes.label: Atomic save (write data.json.tmp then rename)
nodes.rationale: Writing to a temp file and renaming over data.json avoids a half-written file breaking the whole site.

nodes.label: Localhost-only API guard (127.0.0.1, host check, X-GM header)
nodes.rationale: Answers only on 127.0.0.1, rejects other host names and requires an X-GM header on every API call so other websites cannot reach it.
nodes.norm_label: localhost-only api guard (127.0.0.1, host check, x-gm header)

nodes.label: Publish flow (git add docs, commit Update portfolio, push)
nodes.norm_label: publish flow (git add docs, commit update portfolio, push)

nodes.label: Saved view and theme picked before first paint
nodes.rationale: Last view saved per browser (or a link ending in dev); Developer mode defaults dark, Spiral defaults light; chosen before first paint to avoid a flash.
nodes.norm_label: saved view and theme picked before first paint

nodes.label: Spiral view (3D helix of project cards)
nodes.rationale: Card i turned i x 40 deg so nine cards make a turn and turns never overlap; only the wrapper moves each frame (preserve-3d in a perspective stage); goal settles on a whole card after 140 ms of stillness.
nodes.norm_label: spiral view (3d helix of project cards)

nodes.label: Project popup (media grid, details, write-up, links)
nodes.rationale: Waits for the card to reach the front (or 900 ms) then grows out of it; closes on Esc, x, outside click or resting on another card for 350 ms.
nodes.norm_label: project popup (media grid, details, write-up, links)

nodes.label: Developer mode terminal
nodes.rationale: Linux-style commands (ls, cd, cat, grep, whoami, mail...); unknown first words fall back to opening a file/project or cd into a folder before command not found.

nodes.label: admin/index.html (Gamemaster dashboard)
nodes.rationale: Local-only three-column shell (project list, editor, side actions) with game-themed labels (Compendium, Game Settings, Game Access); all behaviour lives in admin.js.

nodes.label: Inline theme init script (localStorage.theme or prefers-color-scheme)
nodes.norm_label: inline theme init script (localstorage.theme or prefers-color-scheme)

nodes.label: Portfolio.cmd launcher
nodes.rationale: Double-click entry point: cd to its own folder, checks Node.js with where node (prints nodejs.org hint if missing), runs node server.js, pauses so the console stays open.
